figure.title: Figure 8 (continued). Variation with lift coefficient of the aerodynamic characteristics for wing 3. (b) Drag coefficient.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, on staggered scales. Common axis = the M = 0.50 scale: left frame line = -0.2 (label '-.2'), grid every 0.1 (33 vertical lines, about 62 px apart), right frame line = 3.0. The row of labels under the Mach strip reads '-.2' and then '0' thirteen times, one under every second grid line from common 0.0 to 2.4, each below its Mach number in the strip 'M = 0.50 .696 .843 .892 .916 .941 .965 .990 1.010 1.024 1.088 1.112 1.122', then '.2 .4 .6' of the M = 1.122 scale at common 2.6, 2.8 and 3.0 (the right frame).
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D (common to all Mach numbers). Grid every 0.01 from 0 (the top line of the Mach label strip) to 0.22 (top frame line); labels every 0.02. The C_D = 0 line is not printed right of about common 2.6 (NACA logo box).
figure.content_note: Wing 3 (47 deg sweep, 9 percent thick). One faired polar per Mach number, 13 Mach numbers, hollow symbols with a centre dot, one shape per Mach number: circle 0.50, square 0.696, diamond 0.843, triangle 0.892, inverted triangle 0.916, triangle pointing right 0.941, triangle pointing left 0.965, right triangle with horizontal top and vertical left side 0.990, right triangle with horizontal top and vertical right side 1.010, right triangle with vertical left side and horizontal bottom 1.024, right triangle with vertical right side and horizontal bottom 1.088, D-shape (horizontal top, vertical left side, curved lower right) 1.112, mirrored D-shape 1.122. Shapes were tied to Mach numbers by following each faired curve to its minimum near its own C_L = 0. Only M = 0.50, 0.843, 0.941, 0.990 and 1.112 are read here. Overlapping and repeated symbols: M = 0.50 has two overlapping circles at C_L about -0.07 and three circles stacked at the same C_L (about 0.40), drawn 4 to 7 px apart vertically; M = 0.843 has two diamonds 5 px apart horizontally at C_L about -0.08; M = 0.941 has two triangles overlapping, 5 px apart vertically, at C_L about 0.53; M = 0.990 has two overlapping symbols at C_L about -0.05 and two at C_L about 0.56; M = 1.112 has two D-shapes 4 px apart at C_L about -0.06. Where the order of two symbols at the same C_L is a tie, they are listed by increasing C_D.

calibration.x_definition: Common axis = the M = 0.50 C_L scale (its zero is the third vertical line from the left frame, under the first '0'). Each Mach number's C_L = 0 is the grid line above its '0' label: M 0.50 at 0.0, 0.696 at 0.2, 0.843 at 0.4, 0.892 at 0.6, 0.916 at 0.8, 0.941 at 1.0, 0.965 at 1.2, 0.990 at 1.4, 1.010 at 1.6, 1.024 at 1.8, 1.088 at 2.0, 1.112 at 2.2, 1.122 at 2.4. Reported C_L = common-axis value minus x_offset.
